summary: Completed comprehensive UI/UX testing of SIDETRACK Studios redesign (Iteration 10). All 20 frontend features tested successfully. Stream page polished with hero section, neon progress bar, crystal-glass surfaces. Live Stage redesigned with glassmorphism controls, layout buttons, and LiveChat integration. No backend changes tested (frontend-only iteration).

issues: Some iTunes preview tracks show 'Playback failed' - this is expected behavior when preview URL is unavailable
